drive.title: Voice chat
drive.hint_pause_ptt: Tap the picture to mute. It mutes itself after each reply.
drive.hint_wait_listening: Start talking when it says Listening
drive.hint_offline: Retrying in {s} s. Check your signal.
drive.you_empty: Didn’t catch that — say it again.
drive.undo_available: Undo is available for a few seconds.
drive.undone: Removed. Say it again when you’re ready.
drive.replaced: Voice chat moved to another tab or device.
drive.paused_screen_off: Muted while the screen was off. Listening again.
drive.audio_interrupted: Sound was interrupted by another app. Tap the picture to carry on.
drive.err_locked_device: This bot isn’t available on a locked device.
drive.err_https: Open DisPatch from its https link to use the microphone. The address bar must show a lock.
drive.err_mic_denied: DisPatch can’t use the microphone. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
drive.err_mic_missing: No microphone was found. Plug one in or connect a Bluetooth headset or car kit, then try again.
drive.err_refused: Voice chat stopped: this chat isn’t available on this device right now.
drive.err_unavailable: Voice isn’t set up on this server. Speech models may be missing — see Settings › Voice.
drive.err_internal: Voice chat hit a problem and stopped.
drive.err_internal_retry: Voice chat hit a problem. Reconnecting…
drive.err_network: Still no connection. Check your signal, then try again.
drive.err_tts: The reply couldn’t be spoken. It’s in the chat.
drive.err_send: That didn’t send. Say it again.
drive.err_stt: DisPatch didn’t catch that. Say it again.
drive.err_agent: That didn’t go through. Say it again.
drive.err_nothing_to_say: Nothing to read out — the reply is in the chat.
drive.err_timeout: That took too long. Say it again.
drive.err_undo_expired: Too late to undo — it was already sent.
drive.err_rate: Too much at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
drive.err_generic: Something went wrong with voice. Keep talking, or hang up.
drive.err_preview: Couldn’t play a sample of that voice.
drive.err_settings_missing: This server can’t change voice settings yet.
drive.voice_sheet_hint: This bot’s voice everywhere, saved at once.
drive.patience_hint: Adjusts itself to how you pause.
drive.barge_in_hint: Talk over a reply to stop it. Turn this off if background noise keeps cutting replies short.
drive.interrupt_sensitivity_hint: How sure voice chat must be that it's you before it stops a reply. Low and Normal ignore background talk and noise; High stops at the first sound, as before.
drive.auto_listen_hint: Off: tap the picture each time you want to talk.
drive.sounds_hint: Short tones when DisPatch hears you, when it is ready, and when something fails.
drive.reply_length_hint: Short is one sentence. Longer is a short paragraph.
drive.follow_up_hint: The bot may end a reply with a question. Turn off for quick answers.
drive.screen_on_hint: While voice chat is open. The phone stops listening when the screen locks.
drive.mic_hint: A headset or car microphone usually hears you better than the phone’s own.
drive.speaker: Speaker
drive.speaker_hint: Where replies play on this computer.
drive.captions_hint: Your words as you speak, and the reply, on the voice chat screen.
drive.all_settings_hint: Opens Settings over this screen. The microphone is muted; nothing hangs up.
drive.group_server_hint: Shared by everyone on this server.
drive.default_voice_hint: Used by every bot that has no voice of its own.
drive.voice_users: Used by {names}. Change a bot’s voice on the Bots tab.
drive.voice_users_none: Not in use right now: every bot has a voice of its own. Change that on the Bots tab.
drive.voice_builtin_only: No voice of your own yet, so replies use a built-in voice. Add one with the Voice cloning tool.
drive.speed_hint_cloned: Built-in voices only. A voice of your own speaks at its natural pace.
drive.manage_voices_hint: Record or upload a short clip to add a voice.
drive.engine_cloned: Your voices, with a built-in fallback.
drive.setup_hint: Voice is on, but files it needs are missing on the server. The microphone button appears in chats once they are in place.
drive.thinking_hint: More thinking gives better answers but a longer wait before the reply.
drive.bot_voice_title: The voice this bot speaks with in voice chat
drive.where_backend: In DisPatch’s backend folder on the server:
drive.where_env: In DisPatch’s environment on the server:
drive.switch_hint: Talk with your bots hands-free. Adds a microphone button to chats for everyone on this server.
drive.switch_forced_on: Turned on by the server’s settings (DISPATCH_VOICE=1).
drive.switch_forced_off: Turned off by the server’s settings (DISPATCH_VOICE=0). Whoever runs DisPatch can change that.
drive.switch_forced_error: The server’s settings decide this, so it can’t be changed here.
drive.switched_on: Voice is on. Speech models load in the background.
drive.needs_hint_off: You can turn it on now, but it won’t work until these are installed on the server.
drive.setup_restart: Then restart DisPatch and reopen this page.
drive.setup_docs: See docs/voice-chat/index.md for how to install it.
drive.voice_stock_only: Only the stock voice is installed, so every bot sounds the same. Add your own with the Voice cloning tool.
drive.voice_none_hint: Fetch the add-on’s models for the stock voice and voice cloning, or install the optional built-in voices plugin.
drive.err_voice_off: Voice is turned off. Turn it on in Settings › Voice.
drive.where_start: Then start DisPatch with it installed, from the backend folder:
drive.button_voice_off: Voice chat is turned off in Settings › Voice.
drive.settings_hint: How voice chat listens and speaks. The switch, the voices and role-play text are shared by everyone on this server; everything else applies to this device only.
drive.hint_waiting: No signal — I’ll pick up when you’re back
drive.link_phone: Low signal — using the phone’s voice
drive.link_wait: Low signal — waiting for the voice
drive.link_text: Low signal — replies are shown as text
drive.link_no_phone_voice: This device has no phone voice — replies are shown as text
drive.cut_off: That got cut off. Say it again.
drive.offline_said: No signal. I’ll send that when we’re back.
drive.slow_link_hint: On a weak signal, replies can be read by your phone’s own voice instead of waiting.
drive.slow_always_hint: Fastest replies, in the phone’s voice.
drive.phone_voice_hint: The offline voice your phone reads replies with.
drive.phone_voice_none: This device has no offline voice. Install one under Settings › System › Languages › Text-to-speech output.
drive.phone_voice_sample: Hi, this is how your phone will read replies.
drive.phone_voice_android_hint: Your phone reads replies with the voice chosen under Settings › System › Languages › Text-to-speech output.
drive.local_voice_failed: The phone’s voice isn’t working — replies are shown as text.
drive.reactions_hint: Short words in the bot’s own voice: ‘let me see’ while it works. On Often, also ‘mm-hm’ while you talk, for bots that allow it on the Bots tab.
drive.english_only: Voice chat understands and speaks English only for now.
drive.first_run_hint: Talk over me to interrupt, or say ‘stop’.
drive.first_run_hint_tap: Tap the picture to stop a reply.
drive.hangup_quiet_hint: After this long with nothing said, the bot asks if you’re still there, then hangs up.
drive.rp_speech_hint: What to read aloud in a reply with *actions* and "dialogue".
drive.narrator_voice_hint: Reads the parts that are not dialogue.
drive.err_busy: Voice is busy on this server: too many voice chats are open. Try again in a little while.
drive.status_failed_hint: The server didn’t answer. Check the connection, then try again.
drive.power_held: The computer runs at full speed while a voice chat is open.
drive.power_off: The computer’s power setting is left as it is.
drive.power_unavailable: This computer can’t be held at full speed for voice chats.
drive.bot_backchannel_hint: Short ‘mm-hm’s while you talk, when Reactions is set to Often.
drive.bot_follow_up_hint: This bot may end a reply with a question.
drive.bot_locked_voice_hint: Used only on locked (Safe Mode) devices. Leave it on Same as standard to use the voice above.
drive.rig: Use the GPU rig when available
drive.rig_hint: Faster replies when the rig is on. This computer takes over whenever it isn't.
drive.rig_not_setup: Not set up on this computer
drive.rig_state_idle: Used from the next voice chat.
drive.rig_state_busy: The rig is busy, so this computer is speaking.
drive.rig_state_down: The rig isn't answering, so this computer is speaking.
drive.rig_state_cooling: This computer is speaking; the rig gets another try shortly.
drive.rig_state_misconfigured: The rig refused the token. Check SPEECHFORGE_TOKEN on the server.
drive.rig_state_loading: The rig is loading its models, so this computer is speaking.
drive.rig_state_unleased: It runs without a GPU lease.
drive.type_input_aria: Type a message instead of talking
drive.hint_type: Type below, or tap the picture to unmute
drive.typed_input_hint: Replies are still spoken. The microphone stays muted and a text box stays on the screen — for a headset or a quiet room.
drive.compose_offline: No connection yet — try again in a moment.
drive.compose_too_long: That message is too long — {n} characters at most.
drive.group_stt_hint: Who turns your voice into text.
drive.group_tts_hint: Who speaks the replies, and the voice they use. These apply to everyone on this server.
drive.group_input_hint: How you talk on this device. Stored in this browser.
drive.group_characters_hint: Each character can have its own voice. Changes save at once.
drive.provider_hint_stt: Choose where your speech is recognised.
drive.stt_engine_hint: Moonshine is an optional extra; if it is missing, Parakeet is used.
drive.tts_engine_hint: Automatic picks your cloned voices when they are set up.
drive.stt_url_hint: A server that offers /v1/audio/transcriptions, such as whisper.cpp.
drive.hq_url_hint: A server that offers /v1/audio/speech. The reply text is sent to it; if it fails, this computer speaks instead.
drive.rig_url_hint: The ws:// or wss:// address of your speech rig. Private, tailnet and local addresses are allowed; a public one needs the administrator's allow-list.
drive.rig_token_hint: Saved in a private file on the server. It is never shown or logged.
drive.rig_token_env: The server's environment provides the token.
drive.rig_shared_note: The rig recognises speech and speaks replies; it falls back to this computer when it is busy or unreachable.
drive.rig_shared_tts: The same rig connection as speech recognition (set up under Speech to text).
drive.set_by_env_hint: The server's environment decides this setting. Change or remove the variable there.
drive.plugins_hint: Installed add-ons that bring more voices or recognisers.
drive.plugin_gpl: Kokoro voices are GPL-3.0 licensed and installed separately.
drive.models_hint: About 1.4 GB, downloaded once. Needed for voice on this computer.
drive.models_restart: Restart DisPatch to use cloned voices.
drive.models_legacy: Models are in the old folders
drive.models_legacy_hint: Move them into the single models folder. Nothing is overwritten.
drive.input_mode_hint: Hands-free listens all the time; push to talk waits for you; type and speak lets you type while replies are spoken.
drive.mic_test_hint: Speak and watch the bar. The readout shows the delay this device adds.

voices.title: Voices
voices.intro: A voice is built on this computer from a short clip of one person talking. It stays here.
voices.builtin_hint: Play a sample, then set it as the default if you like it.
voices.add_title: Record now, or upload a clip
voices.add_hint: 10–20 seconds of one person talking. Quiet room, no music.
voices.none: No voices of your own yet
voices.none_hint: Replies use a built-in voice until you add one.
voices.delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? This removes the clip and the voice from this computer.
voices.rec_hint: Relaxed, like you’re talking to a friend. About 20 seconds. Read it in English: the voice engine speaks English.
voices.script: Hey, welcome back to the show. So, I’ve been thinking about this all week, and honestly? It’s one of those things that sounds simple until you actually look at it. Here’s the part that got me. Okay, are you ready for this?
voices.clip_ok: This clip works. Give the voice a name and say whose voice it is.
voices.clip_bad: This clip can’t be used. See the red notes above.
voices.name: Name
voices.consent_permission: I have the speaker’s explicit permission to clone this voice.
voices.consent_synthetic: This is a synthetic or stock voice, not a real person.
voices.building: Building the voice. This takes a few seconds on this computer…
voices.built: “{name}” is ready. Play a sample to hear it.
voices.engine: Voice engine: Chatterbox Turbo ({engine}), running on this computer.
voices.engine_wm: Voice engine: Chatterbox Turbo ({engine}), running on this computer. Its output carries an inaudible AI watermark.
voices.engine_off: The voice engine isn’t loaded on this server, so voices can’t be built here right now.
voices.stock_hint: Comes with DisPatch Voice. Synthetic, not a real person.
voices.none_hint_stock: Replies use the stock voice until you add one.
voices.builtin_plugin: None installed. Built-in voices come from an optional plugin, such as {name} ({licence}), which is installed separately.

vtools.cloning_sub: Your voices, built on this computer
vtools.lab_sub: Engines, timing and a quick test
vtools.cloning_missing_hint: The voice cloning engine is part of DisPatch Voice. Reinstall the add-on and fetch its models (about 690 MB), then restart DisPatch.
vtools.cloning_models: dispatch-voice is installed, but not its models
vtools.cloning_models_hint: Fetch the models once (about 690 MB), then restart DisPatch.
vtools.cloning_voice_off: You can add voices now. Voice chat uses them once voice is turned on.
vtools.builtin_about: Built-in voices come from {name}, a plugin licensed {licence}. It is installed separately and never ships with DisPatch, which is MIT.
vtools.builtin_missing_hint: It is an optional plugin, distributed separately (no download link here). Fetch its models in the plugin’s folder, then start DisPatch with the plugin enabled.
vtools.builtin_not_enabled: The plugin is installed but not enabled
vtools.builtin_not_enabled_hint: Add it to DISPATCH_VOICE_EXTENSIONS, then restart DisPatch.
vtools.builtin_models_hint: Fetch them from the plugin’s folder, then restart DisPatch.
vtools.builtin_empty_hint: The plugin is loaded but lists no voices. Check its models.
vtools.builtin_list_hint: Play a sample, then set the one you like as the default.
vtools.builtin_voice_off: Samples play once voice is turned on.
vtools.preview_needs_voice: Turn voice on to play samples
vtools.lab_voice_off: Off. The microphone button is hidden and no speech models are loaded.
vtools.models_warm: Loaded and warmed up in {s} s.
vtools.cloud_hint: Shown here, changed on the server: keys and addresses stay in the server’s environment.
vtools.minimax_how: To use it, set these on the server and restart:
vtools.hq_how: An OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint, such as a GPU box. DisPatch uses the local voice whenever it is slow or busy.
vtools.timing_hint: For everyone on this server. Applies from the next voice chat.
vtools.merge_hint: Start talking again within this time after a pause and it counts as the same message.
vtools.hard_silence_hint: Silence that always ends your turn, even mid-sentence. Raise it if you get cut off.
vtools.reset_hint: Put the timing and thinking back to the server’s defaults.
vtools.show_timings: Show timings on the voice chat screen
vtools.show_timings_hint: How long recognition and the first word of each reply took. This device only.
vtools.test_hint: Say a short sentence. DisPatch writes down what it heard and says it back in the default voice.
vtools.test_needs_voice: Turn voice on, and finish setting it up, to run a test.
vtools.expressive_tags_hint: Lets a cloned voice laugh or sigh where the bot writes [laugh] or [sigh].
vtools.acks_hint: Short lines like “Let me see” that each voice says while a reply is on its way. Rendered once per voice, on this computer.
vtools.decoder_prompt_hint: Shorter = faster, longer = closer to the clip.
vtools.stt_engine_hint: Parakeet is the default. Moonshine is an optional extra.
vtools.timing_link_hint: Round trip, bitrate and which voice spoke.
vtools.group_last: Last voice chat on this device
vtools.last_none_hint: Numbers appear here after a voice chat on this device.
vtools.learned_value: Waits {hold} ms after a pause (checks at {probe} ms).
vtools.learned_none: Nothing learned yet on this device.
vtools.learned_reset_done: Learned pause cleared on this device.
vtools.rig_idle: standing by for the next voice chat
vtools.rig_reason_voice: a voice wasn't on the rig yet
vtools.rig_limits: Limits: {sessions} voice chats, {contexts} replies at once, {ahead} s ahead
vtools.rig_deadlines: Deadlines: final words {final} ms, first audio {start} ms
vtools.rig_how: SpeechForge on a GPU machine. Set its address in voice.yaml (rig.url) and its token in this server's environment. This computer takes over whenever the rig is slow, busy or away.
vtools.rig_loading: loading its models, using this computer
vtools.rig_lease_unleased: none, the rig runs without one
